attempts.rationale: With per-request freshness (A), revoking the collaborator role makes the subject's next GET on the private repo return 404. With per-session caching (B), the subject's role is cached during the first GET, so the same GET after revocation still succeeds, failing the probe. The DELETE revoke route is absent in base and B, so those worlds report n/a. If A's revoke did nothing, the subject would remain a collaborator and callAgain would also return 200, causing a failure.
